summary: Install-time beacon to hardcoded bare-IP collector; package body is an inert Proxy stub
details: The package is a dependency-confusion/recon lure targeting the @grabcad scope. index.js exports a Proxy that returns a no-op for every property access, so the package provides none of the functionality its name advertises. Its only observable behavior is a beacon: both the postinstall script and a require-time side effect in index.js invoke beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON payload containing the package name, os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and process.version to the hardcoded plaintext-HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The destination is a bare IP with no TLS, is not a registry, publisher, or documented service, and the collected fields confirm successful installation on an internal host under the targeted scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
